description: This file defines classes, functions, and enums related to notification forwarding policies, including filtering modes, quiet hours, and rate limiting within an Android app.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the notification forwarding settings, including filtering mode, quiet hours, rate limits, and associated packages.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: Class managing rate limiting of notification events to prevent excessive notifications within a time window.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Creates a NotificationPackageFilterMode from a raw string value.

methods.name: allowsPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is allowed based on the current filter mode and list of packages.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Checks if the current time falls within the defined quiet hours period.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a string representing a local hour and minute to the format HH:MM if valid.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a string representing a local hour and minute to total minutes from midnight.

methods.name: allow
methods.description: Determines if a notification event is allowed based on rate limiting.
